name: Tokens / Go Wide
summary: Token producers, doublers, anthems, and wide finishers that close the game through a swarm of creatures. Absorbs the amass-orcs and amass-armies idioms (same mechanic, different franchise).
_status_note: Live recipe — Gate 2 + Gate 3 approved 2026-05-14 by local-board via combined confirmation interaction 484154d5. 20/20 = 100% canon recall validated empirically against Scryfall API.

canon_approval._note: Canon (Gate 2) and recipe (Gate 3) approved together in a single combined confirmation, mirroring the graveyard-reanimator collapsed-gate path now that the methodology is proven.

canon_provenance.from_existing_decks: Pulled from `mutant-multiplication`, `witherbloom-the-balancer`, and `gathering-shadow` deck.json (the three decks tagged `tokens-go-wide`). Shared staples: Anointed Procession, Parallel Lives, Doubling Season, Mondrak, Cathars' Crusade, Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Tendershoot Dryad, Mycoloth, Avenger of Zendikar, Adeline (mutant); Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Mycoloth, Tendershoot, Avenger, Pawn of Ulamog (witherbloom); Grishnákh, Gothmog (gathering-shadow amass).
canon_provenance.from_edhrec_archetype_pages: Intangible Virtue, Triumph of the Hordes, Pathbreaker Ibex, Scute Swarm, Krenko Mob Boss, Academy Manufactor, Ojer Taq — universal EDH tokens staples ranking in top-30 across Adeline/Krenko/Rhys/Ghave/Marrow-Gnawer pages and the EDHREC `tokens` archetype landing.
canon_provenance.from_franchise_subarchetypes: Grishnákh (amass orcs) and Gothmog (amass armies) anchor the absorbed amass sub-recipes per `docs/archetype-taxonomy.md` board directive — same mechanic, two LOTR-set franchise variants.
canon_provenance.from_combo_pieces: Mondrak + sacrifice loops, Doubling Season + planeswalker ultimates, Bitterblossom + Contamination, and Scute Swarm + Fabled Passage lines all show up on Commander Spellbook for tokens combos; these canon picks anchor the well-known engines.

token_doublers.intent: Replacement effects that double or triple the number of tokens created under your control — the multiplicative engine of every serious tokens deck.

recurring_upkeep_token_engines.intent: Permanents that drip out creature tokens at each upkeep — passive fodder/army builders that scale with turns.
queries: f:commander o:"beginning of" o:upkeep o:create o:"creature token"

mass_etb_token_producers.intent: Creatures that flood the board with tokens scaled to game state (lands, opponents, mana) on ETB.
queries: f:commander t:creature o:enters o:create o:"creature token" o:"for each"

landfall_token_producers.intent: Landfall-triggered token engines — pair naturally with fetch and Fabled Passage ramp.

token_anthems.intent: Static and counter-based anthems that turn the swarm into lethal damage. Splits the well-known idioms: pump-tokens-only enchantments (Intangible Virtue) and ETB-counter pile-on (Cathars' Crusade).
queries: f:commander t:enchantment o:"creature tokens you control get"
f:commander o:"creature you control enters" o:"+1/+1 counter"

wide_finishers.intent: Global pumps that convert a board of small creatures into a kill — trample/infect/scaling power. The reason go-wide closes games rather than stalling.
queries: f:commander o:"creatures you control get +1/+1" o:infect
f:commander o:"creatures you control gain trample" o:"greatest power"

amass_payoffs.intent: Amass mechanic (orcs and armies franchises absorbed per taxonomy). Catches the LOTR amass commanders + every amass spell/permanent.

token_utility_engines.intent: Replacement effects on non-creature token creation (treasure/clue/food) that bend the token economy — Academy Manufactor and its kin.
queries: f:commander o:"if you would create" o:treasure o:clue

per_opponent_token_producers.intent: Token creation scaled per-opponent — pod-format multiplier that ignores in 1v1 but explodes in 4-player commander.
queries: f:commander o:"for each opponent" o:create o:"creature token"

tokens_commanders.intent: Tribal-token commanders — the activated/triggered engines that anchor mono-color go-wide decks (Krenko being the canonical Goblin example, but the query parameterizes on tribe at runtime).
queries: is:commander t:goblin o:create o:goblin o:"creature token"

canon_recall.note: Tribe is parameterized — swap `t:goblin` / `o:goblin` for `t:elf` / `o:elf` etc. at runtime when the deck's `tribe` field is set. Tribal recipes are out of scope here; this query is the goblin instance because Krenko anchors canon.

x_spell_token_makers.intent: Instant/sorcery spells with {X} in their mana cost that create X creature tokens. Uniquely powerful in tokens decks because they scale with available mana, get copied at the same X by 'copy that spell' effects (Aziza, Reverberate, Bonus Round) per CR 707.4, and convert late-game excess mana into board state.
queries: f:commander (t:instant OR t:sorcery) o:"create x" o:"creature token"

noise_examples: Artifact Mutation / Aura Mutation (X-from-mana-value rider on removal)
canon_recall._note: Conqueror's Pledge and Decree of Justice use kicker/cycling X-scaling rather than X-in-base-cost; they don't match this query. Wildcard or a dedicated kicker/cycling sub-recipe would catch them.

wildcard.intent: Intentionally broad sweep — catches new printings whose oracle text doesn't match the precise sub-recipes above. High noise, run sparingly.

canon_recall.note: Wildcard is not validated against canon — it exists to surface novel token producers the precise queries miss (e.g., set-mechanic-specific tokens like Saproling/Treefolk/Thopter waves).

excludes._note: Optional post-fetch filter. Prevents symmetric token-givers (e.g., Hunted Wumpus-style) leaking when the deck doesn't want to feed opponents. Splice for decks tagged asymmetric_only:true.

runtime_semantics.color_identity_splice: Append `id<=<deck color identity>` per query at runtime.
runtime_semantics.decklist_exclusion: Post-fetch — filter out any name already in decklist or candidates.json top-50.
runtime_semantics.tribe_parameterization: For the `tokens_commanders` sub-recipe, substitute the deck's tribal tag at runtime when present. Otherwise default to goblin (highest-recall tribal instance for tokens-go-wide).

validation_summary.validation_method: Each sub-recipe query was run live against api.scryfall.com (order=edhrec). Canon recall = (canon cards surfaced by at least one query in any sub-recipe) / total canon.

noise_sample.token_doublers: Doubling Season, Anointed Procession, Branching Evolution, Parallel Lives, Mondrak, Innkeeper's Talent, Elspeth Storm Slayer, Primal Vigor — top-10 are all token/counter doublers. Branching Evolution is a counter-doubler (adjacent archetype), clean otherwise. Tripler query is tight: Ojer Taq only.
noise_sample.recurring_upkeep_token_engines: Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Thopter Spy Network, Bonehoard Dracosaur, Koma Cosmos Serpent, Tendershoot Dryad, Dragonmaster Outcast, Windcrag Siege, Awakening Zone, Beledros Witherbloom, Court of Grace, Skrelv's Hive, Assemble the Legion, Mycoloth, Endless Ranks of the Dead — strong upkeep-token signal across artifact/enchantment/creature variants.
noise_sample.mass_etb_token_producers: Avenger of Zendikar, Urza Lord High Artificer, Terastodon, Hangarback Walker, Diregraf Colossus, Hooded Hydra, Izoni Thousand-Eyed, Phylath World Sculptor — all mass-token ETB creatures, no false positives in top-10.
noise_sample.landfall_token_producers: Scute Swarm, Avenger of Zendikar, Rampaging Baloths, Felidar Retreat, Springheart Nantuko, Omnath Locus of Rage, Zendikar's Roil, Emeria Angel — clean landfall-tokens cluster.
noise_sample.token_anthems: Anthem query: Intangible Virtue, Caretaker's Talent, Inspiring Leader, Invasion of Tolvada, Dramatic Finale — Caretaker's Talent is `+1/+1 to attacking tokens` (legitimate tokens anthem). Crusade query: The Great Henge, Champion of Lambholt, Cathars' Crusade, Tribute to the World Tree, Guide of Souls — first few are counter-pile-on triggers; Cathars' Crusade is canonical.
noise_sample.wide_finishers: Infect query: Triumph of the Hordes (1 result — tight). Trample/greatest-power query: Overwhelming Stampede, Pathbreaker Ibex (2 results — tight cluster, both wide-pump staples).
noise_sample.amass_payoffs: Orcish Bowmasters, Dreadhorde Invasion, Barad-dûr, Lazotep Plating, Gleaming Overseer, Sauron the Dark Lord, Saruman the White Hand, Gothmog Morgul Lieutenant, Grishnákh Brash Instigator — clean amass franchise. Includes both 'amass Orcs' and 'amass Armies' variants.
noise_sample.token_utility_engines: Academy Manufactor only — extremely tight, no false positives.
noise_sample.per_opponent_token_producers: Adeline Resplendent Cathar, Tempt with Bunnies, Aclazotz Deepest Betrayal, Ainok Strike Leader, Tempt with Vengeance, In the Darkness Bind Them, Welcome to Jurassic Park — strong per-opponent token signal with some adjacent token-givers.
noise_sample.tokens_commanders: Krenko Tin Street Kingpin, Krenko Mob Boss, General Kreat the Boltbringer, Pashalik Mons, Squee Dubious Monarch, Krenko Baron of Tin Street, Ardoz Cobbler of War, Ib Halfheart Goblin Tactician, Wort the Raidmother — all canonical goblin-token commanders.
noise_sample.wildcard: Broad sweep — used to surface unusual token producers like Welcoming Vampire, Springheart Nantuko, Anim Pakal Thousandth Moon, Faerie Slumber Party that the precise queries miss.

_dec_299_note: v2 (2026-05-27, DEC-299): Added x_spell_token_makers sub-recipe to surface X-cost instant/sorcery token spells (Secure the Wastes, Martial Coup, Grand Crescendo, Forth Eorlingas!, etc.) — uniquely powerful in tokens decks via mana-scaling + spell-copy interaction. Identified as a structural gap during Aziza DEC-299 build where v1 shipped with zero X-spell token-makers.
